## 🚀 Feature Description

If you have ideas about how this should look or behave, please describe them.

## 📸 Mockups/Examples
If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or examples from other sites.

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
Any technical details or considerations for implementation.

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
